plan.purpose: Help the person reviewing extracted invoices check the amounts, identify who billed whom, and verify uncertain details against the source.
plan.title: Review extracted invoices
plan.composition: Use a full-width, unboxed result with a quiet header and a vertical sequence of invoice records in the order returned. Repeat one flat Stack over /result; all record-level bindings below read the listed relative paths from the current item. Each record opens with the vendor and document type, followed immediately by a three-column amount band, then the purchase details and two equal columns for seller and buyer. Keep classification reasoning, tax rates and source text in one closed Collapsible at the end of each record; separate records with a hairline. Columns stack on narrow screens. Use only h1 and h2 headings, neutral surfaces, and theme-aware text and borders; reserve the accent for the document-type badge. Do not add a sidebar, request summary, footer, run control, inferred currency or calculated aggregate.

regions.purpose: Name the review task without inventing a single-invoice title for a list, and provide the host's placement for result actions.
elements: ResultHeader — static title "Review extracted invoices" as the page's only h1; no eyebrow or subtitle; host-owned result actions at the right.

regions.purpose: Present each extracted document as a readable financial record, with amounts first and supporting evidence folded away.
elements: Stack — repeat over /result using $state, preserving list order; contains the record header, amount Grid, purchase details, party Split, verification Collapsible and an inter-record Separator. Descendants read the current item's relative paths with $item unless delegated.
Stack — horizontal record header holding Heading and Badge; wraps on narrow screens.
Heading — vendor, read with $item; h2; hide when empty.
Badge — category/category, read with $item; display the returned choice verbatim: "bill" | "receipt"; hide when empty.
Grid — three columns, stacking on narrow screens; holds the total, net and tax Detail elements in that order.
Detail — amount_incl_tax, read with $item; label "Total including tax"; show the number without adding a currency or unit.
Detail — amount_excl_tax, read with $item; label "Before tax"; show the number without adding a currency or unit.
Detail — vat_amount, read with $item; label "Tax"; show the number without adding a currency or unit.
Stack — purchase details holding the document number, date, time and description; no additional heading.
Detail — invoice_number, read with $item; label "Document number".
Stack — horizontal, holding Text "Issued" and DateText; hide the whole line when issue_date is empty.
DateText — issue_date, read with $item; format "long", tone muted.
Detail — time, read with $item; label "Time"; preserve the extracted text.
Detail — description, read with $item; label "Purchase"; wrap the full text.
Split — ratio "1:1"; exactly two child Stacks, seller first and buyer second; stack on narrow screens; hide a party Stack when all its fields are empty.
Stack — seller details holding vendor_address, vendor_siret and vendor_vat_number; no repeated vendor name.
Detail — vendor_address, read with $item; label "Seller address".
Detail — vendor_siret, read with $item; label "SIRET".
Detail — vendor_vat_number, read with $item; label "VAT number".
Stack — buyer details holding company_name and company_address.
Detail — company_name, read with $item; label "Buyer".
Detail — company_address, read with $item; label "Buyer address".
Collapsible — trigger "Check the extraction"; initially closed; contains classification reasoning, tax rates and source text in a Stack; hide when all three are empty.
Detail — category/explanation, read with $item; label "Why this document type".
MthdsResult — relative path vat_rates within each repeated item; keep its own label; omit when empty; delegate the numeric list whole.
Text — static label "Source text", muted; shown only when text is nonempty.
Text — text, read with $item; preserve line breaks and wrap long lines; shown only when nonempty.
Separator — between repeated records only; no trailing separator.

delegated: vat_rates — relative to each item in /result; MthdsResult renders the numeric list whole.

# Result page: invoice_extraction.process_invoice

Process relevant information from an invoice

## Frame

This page is the result page of an app that is composed, then shows its result: what the person sees after one run. The host draws what surrounds it: the band with the team's logo and the app's name, then a bar restating the request with a way back to edit it and to run again. The host also owns the actions on the result, such as downloading or sharing it, and places them where the page's header puts them. There is no side panel, no app bar and no footer to build, and nothing restates the request.

The page is the result across the full width. It opens on its header, which names the result in a person's words, read from the result itself where it can be (the page's h1). Then the figure or the fact a person looks for first, then the body of the result in the shape it naturally has: a plan day by day, options side by side to compare, a record's details. Lay out what a person reads; leave out what only a machine would.

Show each value once: a figure a component already states, such as the total inside a ProportionBar, is not repeated beside it. When the result carries the request back - the same facts the person entered, such as the topic or the tone they chose - leave that part out: the host's bar already restates the request. Write a value as a person reads it: a date in words, an amount beside its currency when the result has one.

## State

The host loads the run's result under `/result` before the page renders. Read every value with `$state`; emit no `/state` patches. Paths:

- `/result` — list of structure invoice_extraction.Invoice — `output`: Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts
  - each item is a structure invoice_extraction.Invoice (Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts), with these members (paths relative to one item, for DataTable columns or $item):
    - `invoice_id` — text — `invoice_id`: Unique identifier for the invoice
    - `invoice_number` — text — `invoice_number`: Invoice number as shown on the document
    - `issue_date` — date — `issue_date`: Date when the invoice was issued
    - `time` — text — `time`: Time of the transaction if available
    - `amount_incl_tax` — number — `amount_incl_tax`: Total amount including taxes
    - `amount_excl_tax` — number — `amount_excl_tax`: Net amount excluding taxes
    - `vat_amount` — number — `vat_amount`: Total VAT/tax amount
    - `vat_rates` — list of number — `vat_rates`: List of VAT rates applied
      - each item is a number
    - `vendor` — text — `vendor`: Name of the vendor/seller
    - `vendor_address` — text — `vendor_address`: Complete address of the vendor
    - `vendor_siret` — text — `vendor_siret`: SIRET number of the vendor (French company registration)
    - `vendor_vat_number` — text — `vendor_vat_number`: VAT registration number of the vendor
    - `company_name` — text — `company_name`: Name of the purchasing company
    - `company_address` — text — `company_address`: Address of the purchasing company
    - `description` — text — `description`: Description of goods or services purchased
    - `category` — structure invoice_extraction.InvoiceDetails — `category`: Category or type of expense
      - `category/category` — choice of "bill" | "receipt" — `category`: The category of the invoice
      - `category/explanation` — text — `explanation`: Explanation of the classification
    - `text` — text — `text`: Raw text extracted from the invoice

## Delegated

None. `MthdsResult` remains available for any structure you choose not to lay out.

## One real run, as loaded

The state of one actual run, so you can judge magnitudes and lengths. Bind to the paths; do not copy these values into the spec.
